fold: The clatter of looms follows you through <N>, from # shutter to the next.

why: clatter of looms through the streets is ordinary working life under a siege and famine that stopped field work and trade

text: A caravan broker shouts terms to a line of laden animals and the people leading them.
why: a caravan broker haggling over a line of laden animals reads as busy trade; the town has no market and little trade stops under famine

text: A money changer sits at his table with coins from many mints.
